```scheme
 
(define (make-tree op left right)
  (list op left right))
 
(define (op tree)
  (car tree))
 
(define (left tree)
  (cadr tree))
 
(define (right tree)
  (caddr tree))
 
(define (leaf? tree)
  (not (pair? tree)))
 
(define (tree->string tree)
  (if (leaf? tree)
      (number->string (op tree))
      (let ((op (op tree))
	    (left (tree->string (left tree)))
	    (right (tree->string (right tree))))
	(string-append "(" left " " op " " right ")"))))
 
(define (parse-infix s)
  (define (parse-infix-helper s stack)
    (cond ((null? s)
	   (if (= (length stack) 1)
	       (car stack)
	       '()))
	  ((or (eq? (car s) '+) (eq? (car s) '-))
	   (parse-infix-helper (cdr s)
				(list (make-tree (car s)
						 (car stack)
						 (cadr stack))
					  (cddr stack))))
	  ((or (eq? (car s) '*))
	   (parse-infix-helper (cdr s)
				(list (make-tree (car s)
						 (car stack)
						 (cadr stack))
					  (cddr stack))))
	  (else
	   (parse-infix-helper (cdr s)
			       (cons (car s) stack)))))
  (parse-infix-helper (reverse (string-split s #\space))
		      '()))
 
(parse-infix "2")
(parse-infix "2 + 3")
(parse-infix "2 * 3")
(parse-infix "2 + 3 * 4")
(parse-infix "(2 + 3) * 4")
(parse-infix "2 + (3 * 4)")
(parse-infix "2 + 3 * 4 - 5 / (6 + 7)")
```
